document.abstract: Some characteristics of 16-mm. sound by optical reduction and re-recording from 35-mm. film are discussed: by means of loss curves characteristic of the two methods; by reviewing the effects upon the sound quality of compensation for such losses; and by noting the effects, other than simple output loss, that arise in some of the steps of each process.
